title: Malleability vs. Brittleness vs. Ductility
description: Educational tool comparing three material properties: malleability (plastic deformation when cold), brittleness (fracture without plastic deformation), and ductility (plastic elongation without fracture). Includes calculators for percent elongation and percent reduction of area.

components.content:
## Material Properties Overview

### Malleability
A material can be plastic deformed and shaped when cold. Malleable materials can be shaped with hammering or rolling without fracture.

**Typical materials:** mild steel, gold, lead

### Brittleness
A material will fracture without appreciable prior plastic deformation. The elastic stage is followed by immediate fracture.

**Typical materials:** glass, concrete, ceramics, stone, gray cast iron

### Ductility
A material can be plastic deformed by elongation without fracture. Ductile materials typically can be elongated more than 15% before fracture.

**Typical materials:** copper, mild steel, thermoplastics
